title: Write a file
description: Create a text file with 5 lines using PrintWriter.
hints: Close the PrintWriter in a finally block or with try-with-resources
solutionExplanation: PrintWriter with try-with-resources creates the file and writes each line with println(). It is closed automatically when leaving the block.

title: Save notes
description: Save the notes of an ArrayList to a text file, one per line.
hints: Use a for or for-each loop to iterate over the ArrayList
Print how many notes were saved
solutionExplanation: The ArrayList is iterated with a for-each and each element is written to the file using println().

title: Log append
description: Add timestamped entries to the end of a file (append mode) without deleting existing content.
hints: Use new FileWriter("log.txt", true) to enable append mode
Format the date with DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss")
solutionExplanation: The second parameter true in FileWriter enables append mode. LocalDateTime.now() obtains the current date and time, formatted with the specified pattern.
